rp-cut-02.back: Shrubs under 2 m; usually under 20 years.

rp-cut-04.back: Trees over 10 m, densely stocked, overtopping shrubs; little food.

rp-cut-07.front: Which cutblock ages did moose select in one BC study?
rp-cut-07.back: 10 to 30 years since cut; they avoided 0 to 9 and over 30.

rp-cut-08.front: Why do moose still need cover in logged country?
rp-cut-08.back: To hide from predators and hunters, for shade and for shelter in storms.

rp-cut-09.back: Logging creates forage that disappears once the canopy closes.

rp-cut-10.front: Age a block by tree height?
rp-cut-10.back: Knee about 3 to 5 years, head about 8 to 12, twice your height about 15 to 20, dark poles 25 plus (Tip).

rp-cut-13.front: ATV on a Forest Service Road?
rp-cut-13.back: Valid driver's licence and at least $200,000 third party liability insurance.

rp-cut-14.back: $575; serious cases up to $100,000 and/or a year in jail.

rp-cut-15.front: Why worry about new logging roads in moose country?
rp-cut-15.back: More access can lead to over harvesting.

rp-cut-16.back: Bare, then shrubs and deer, then tall shrubs and moose, then dark poles.
